name: smwmusic-winter-gold-fx-medals
title: Winter Gold FX - Medals
description:
Originally made for the Super Famicompo (2nd place!). Probably most suitable for a title-screen, possibly credits? I don't know, takes some creativity.

I mean come on, this was all about the challenge of getting this song ported. Right?

Goal was 1:1 accuracy, and I think I got as close as AMK will allow without horrible lag.
